title: XTP dev34 protected session wire and Queue Fabric durable receipt boundary
summary: Source-review candidate implements a real XtpSession-shaped ooRexx transport collaborator and fail-closed Queue Fabric receipt gate, with r13196 injected-session tests; not yet a qualified authenticated Queue Fabric over XTP implementation.
invariants: XTP dev34 provides per-service encrypt/authenticate on sessions, named messages, streams and multipath. The authoritative LDAP/Secret Broker service key registry is independent of Queue Fabric manager/channel ACL.

XtpSession~open(peer,service,timeout,'encrypt') must be invoked only for a Service Descriptor resolved logical route peer and registered service. Verify PROTECTION, SERVICE, PEER and KEYID before writing payload.
XTP CNTL, ECHO, DIAG, encrypted-session establishment and multicast quorum are not durable Queue Fabric receiver receipts.
Bound reply size and read timeout. A missing/truncated/oversized/unverified response is uncertain; QueueChannelFabric~pump must RELEASE its transmission item, not ACK.

Only the injected authenticated queue.transport/2 proof verifier may turn an XTP application reply into QueueOperationResult success with matched transferId, queueName, source manager and durable receipt markers.
Queue Fabric v0.9-dev6 TCP/TLS socket transport remains independently supported. SocketSelector and ConnectSelector are not replaced by an XTP-only selector.

Candidate local ZIP sha256 8e941fdbbb2df8aad1bbf5ebe050a6d0498cb7b8b416f3c82c7b319f8dc2d9ce passed 18 session-wire and 13 receipt-gate r13196 mock assertions. GitHub source review variant requires its own execution before promotion.

Still missing actual queue.transport/2 over XTP server/client authentication, graph codec, remote UOW reply, live LDAP/Secret Broker provisioning, Planner/WLU admission, multicast durable per-manager repair and ED209 MI-MU L2/raw36/authorized UDP field tests.
Autobuilder is stopped on 2026-10-29; the candidate branch is neither installed nor accepted source.

provenance.claim: Per-service key source and cryptographic scope.
New candidate source-only collaborator; qualification pending.
